These fixtures are original one-second sine waves at 440/660 Hz and a solid-color cover, generated by `scripts/generate-fixtures.py`; `tone.m4a` is `tone.flac` encoded to AAC by ffmpeg with the moov box first. They contain no commercial music or artwork and are distributed under this project's GPL-3.0 license. Tests use these checked-in files; Python dependencies and ffmpeg are only required to regenerate them.
